learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to formulate and justify the goals, contents, and standards of vocational education in technical-vocational professions within the context of the training objective.
Students are able to plan, prepare, conduct, and evaluate lessons.
Students are able to systematize methods and media specific to teaching, select and use them appropriately for content and target group.
Students are able to incorporate subject-specific characteristics of mechanical engineering and electrical engineering into didactic concepts.
Students are able to plan, conduct, and subsequently reflect on a teaching sequence.
Students are able to structure technical content in a learning field-oriented manner and transform it didactically.
Students are able to select suitable examination forms and justify their selection.

syllabus_topics: Educational goals and educational standards, framework curricula and training plans, guidelines
Didactic foundations of vocational specializations (including the learning field concept in mechanical and electrical engineering professions)
Theories, models, methods, and media (especially planning of teaching and learning processes, problem-solving strategies in action-oriented teaching)
Use of analog and digital communication, presentation, and teaching/learning techniques
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination.
